title: Add Video Player
content: Create video player. Container: relative aspect-video bg-black rounded-lg overflow-hidden. Video: w-full h-full object-contain. Controls overlay: absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 p-4 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80, opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition. Controls: flex items-center gap-3, play/pause button, progress bar, time display, volume, fullscreen button.

variants.simple: Create custom video player with playback controls.
variants.detailed: Create video player. Container: relative aspect-video bg-black rounded-lg overflow-hidden. Video: w-full h-full object-contain. Controls overlay: absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 p-4 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80, opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition. Controls: flex items-center gap-3, play/pause button, progress bar, time display, volume, fullscreen button.
variants.advanced: Create full-featured video player. Video element: playsinline, poster image, multiple sources for format fallback. Controls bar: auto-hide after 3s inactivity, show on mouse move or tap. Playback: play/pause (center click also toggles), seek bar with preview thumbnails on hover, buffered indicator. Time: current / duration, click to toggle remaining. Volume: slider, mute button, remember preference. Speed: playback rate selector (0.25x to 2x). Quality: resolution selector if multiple sources (auto, 1080p, 720p, 480p). Captions: subtitle track support, toggle button, style options. Fullscreen: button and double-click, ESC to exit. PiP: Picture-in-Picture support. Keyboard: Space play/pause, F fullscreen, M mute, arrows seek/volume, 0-9 jump to percentage. Settings gear: opens panel with quality, speed, captions. Loading: spinner overlay while buffering. Error handling: display error message, retry button. Mobile: tap to toggle controls, swipe to seek, double-tap sides to skip. Chapters: if provided, markers on seek bar, chapter title display. End screen: replay button, related videos. Analytics hooks: play, pause, progress events. Accessibility: all controls labeled, captions, keyboard support.
